Technology, Reimagined
PM Norway is always chasing new ideas and teaming up with some of the best innovators out there. It’s all about pushing boundaries and building what’s next.
Beyond Products
We’re not in the business of pushing products. We’re here to provide expertise, practical insight, and reliable guidance. By working closely with our clients, we make sure you benefit from our experience and strong technical knowledge.
Precision Logistics
We’re pros at juggling manufacturers, shippers, and tricky delivery schedules — and we move fast while doing it. With plenty of experience and a hands-on approach, we keep everything running smoothly, so you don’t have to worry about the details or delays.
Globally Connected
Our worldwide partner network allows us to deliver global services with the understanding, flexibility, and responsiveness of a local provider. By combining international reach with strong local knowledge, we make sure our clients receive consistent, reliable support wherever they operate.l.

pages.title: PM Norway AS

pages.main_text_excerpt:
About us
Established in 2007 by industry experts with extensive experience in welding and pipe equipment, PM Norway has grown to become a leading supplier of tools and equipment for the oil and gas sector.
Our warehouse offers a comprehensive selection of high-quality products, including welding consumables, purging tools, pipe tools, pipe weld purging systems, welding masks, MIG/TIG torches, tungsten electrodes, grinders, measuring equipment, protective fiberglass, and more. We take pride in offering well-recognized brands known for their superior quality. Our goal is to serve as a long-term partner for our customers, leveraging our expertise to streamline their operations and enhance cost efficiency.
PM Norway is ISO 9001:2015 and Achilles certified, underscoring our commitment to quality and reliability.
Additionally, we are known for offering exclusive, hard-to-find items that set us apart in the industry.
Why Chose us?
PM Norway specializes in providing high-quality products and services in welding, pipe equipment, special tools, and exotic materials.
Many may wonder how we manage to offer such a diverse range while maintaining exceptional quality at every level. The key lies in our strong partnerships with top-tier suppliers.
By collaborating with suppliers who understand and meet our stringent requirements for performance, specifications, efficiency, and documentation, we ensure that our customers are in reliable hands.
Additionally, our commitment to innovation sets us apart. We continuously stay informed about market developments and have a long-standing tradition of being early adopters of new technologies. Our solution-oriented and creative approach enables us to provide both new and existing customers with efficient, cost-effective solutions that enhance their daily operations.
With over 50 years of industry experience, we are well-equipped to meet your needs. We look forward to hearing from you!
